weeks.label: Week of Jul 20, 2026
weeks.summary: This week we expanded the Updates archive with recent release notes and improved how weekly statistics are presented to users. These changes make it easier to review recent changes and understand your weekly metrics across languages.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Weekly statistics labels were refined for clearer, localized wording so metric names and summaries are easier to read across languages.

weeks.label: Week of Jun 22, 2026
weeks.summary: This week focused on improving AI-generated research takeaways for clarity and reliability, while polishing the study summary UI and reducing authentication interruptions.

sections.title: Highlights
items: AI-generated research takeaways are more accurate and actionable: the assistant no longer assigns severity ratings, ignores standard UI chrome when reporting usability issues, and can gracefully handle studies that have no findings.
AI output formatting is more robust: special characters and markup are sanitized so generated takeaways display correctly and avoid broken or malformed content.

Study summary actions are easier to use on all devices: the Add Takeaway button now appears only when relevant and action controls are more responsive on smaller screens, making it simpler to add and find takeaways.
Authentication is more resilient to temporary service interruptions, reducing sign-in disruptions and improving overall reliability.

weeks.label: Week of Jun 15, 2026
weeks.summary: This week’s release improves account reliability, billing consistency, and the notification experience to reduce errors and make behaviours more predictable for users.

sections.title: Highlights
items: More consistent billing and credit purchases: pricing and auto-refill behavior are unified across purchase flows so displayed costs and refill behavior are consistent and predictable.
Improved authentication reliability: resolved a crash during sign-out and addressed related sign-in and walkthrough issues so account actions complete reliably.
Notifications UI improvements: notification counts now display in the correct position and use more appropriate markup for better visual accuracy and accessibility.

weeks.label: Week of Jun 8, 2026
weeks.summary: This week delivers initial multilingual support and improves visual stability: users can select a language, see broader translation coverage, and experience smoother page rendering when loading or switching languages.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Select a preferred language using the new language-selection UI so the app displays in your chosen language.
Broader translation coverage across the interface ensures more screens and messages appear in the selected language for a consistent experience.
Removed brief layout and content flicker during page load and when switching languages to provide a smoother, more polished experience.

weeks.label: Week of May 18, 2026
weeks.summary: This week’s release improves persona chat relevance and the shared-persona experience, and delivers several UI enhancements for clearer lists and more consistent actions.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Persona chat now incorporates study findings so conversations are grounded in relevant research and insights.
Shared persona pages now include public FAQs when accessed via a share link, making shared context and guidance easy to find.
Chat responsiveness and readability improved — responses update more smoothly and the chat panel handles long conversations and overflow more gracefully.
Action controls unified into a compact, inline action button across lists, cards, and menus for more consistent and efficient interactions.
Study and issue views clarified: the benchmark table now shows study names and issue item layouts were refreshed for easier review and scanning.

weeks.label: Week of May 11, 2026
weeks.summary: This week we shipped benchmarking across evaluations and walkthroughs and delivered a series of improvements to interviews: better scheduling, reminders, session lifecycle handling, and clearer notification/auth messaging.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Benchmarks for evaluations and walkthroughs: teams can now generate, view, and manage comparative metrics across flows and personas with an improved UI that makes evaluation scores and comparisons clearer.

Improved interview scheduling and reminders: added a start date for interviews, dynamic reminder counts and smarter scheduling, and pausing an interview now sends participants a confirmation email with a rejoin link; paused sessions are included in session updates.

Better session lifecycle and expiry handling: sessions respect end dates and show a closed-study message when finished, participant and observer links are handled appropriately when sessions expire, and organizers can bulk-cancel expired sessions using a new Cancelled status.

Clearer notifications and sign-in messaging: email notifications now default to sender name “Seer,” email styling and confirmation messages were improved, and the sign-in flow includes clearer verification and error pages.
Fixed reminder timing so paused interview sessions receive notifications at the intended times.

weeks.label: Week of May 4, 2026
weeks.summary: This week’s release improves interview and live session control, audio/AI interaction reliability, team billing visibility, observer accuracy, and adds convenient link copying.

sections.title: Highlights
items: More flexible session lifecycle: you can now pause and resume interviews, end sessions cleanly after the closing message, and recover or mark sessions as INCOMPLETE. Sessions also support an optional name and an estimated duration to set expectations, and the maximum interview length has been increased to 60 minutes.

Smoother audio and conversation flow: audio sources and interruptions are managed more reliably, automatic responses are canceled or delayed when appropriate, and follow-up questions are injected only after a participant has spoken—resulting in fewer overlapping replies and a more natural interaction.

Team balance visibility and automatic adjustments: team balances are now shown in the UI and are automatically updated when sessions are created or deleted, making it easier to track credits and plan sessions without unexpected changes.

Improved observer experience and session status accuracy: the observer view now requires authentication, displays clearer session status (including INCOMPLETE), and stops polling once a session is finished so observers see up-to-date information.
Quick link copying with feedback: you can copy session links directly from interview and live session lists and receive visual confirmation so sharing is faster and more reliable.

weeks.label: Week of Apr 27, 2026
weeks.summary: This week focused on launching interview-style studies and polishing the study and session experience—adding management and billing support for interviews, improving session list clarity and accessibility, and making study navigation more reliable.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Introduce a new interview study type so teams can create and manage interview-based studies directly in the app, with billing support and management tools to run interviews end-to-end.
Improved session and participant lists for clarity and accessibility—participant icons are easier to scan and observer/session links offer better interaction and keyboard/screen-reader support.
Fixed study card navigation so cards open or link consistently, reducing accidental clicks and making it smoother to move between studies.

weeks.label: Week of Apr 20, 2026
weeks.summary: This week we focused on sharing, team management, and evaluation clarity: shared result pages now surface recommendations, study transfers and team deletions are safer and clearer, and evaluation scores are more consistent.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Shared result pages now display expandable study takeaways and updated footer messaging so external viewers see concise recommendations and clearer next steps.
You can transfer studies between teams directly from the study view using a permissions-aware modal; transfers respect team permissions and provide clearer guidance when an action isn’t allowed.

Team deletion now requires confirmation and will automatically move any remaining team balance to the company account; deletion warnings clearly call out when a team has members or studies to review beforehand.
Team listings are easier to scan: balances are shown in dollars and date/member role displays have been simplified for clearer account and membership information.
Evaluation scoring has been made more consistent and easier to interpret, improving clarity of assessment results.

weeks.label: Week of Apr 13, 2026
weeks.summary: This week’s release focuses on sharing and visibility: you can now share qualitative studies publicly, the insights player handles media more gracefully, and teams can receive automated weekly usage summaries by email.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Public sharing for qualitative studies — create shareable links so external stakeholders can view study findings and insights without needing an account.
Better media handling in the insights player — media types are now validated and unsupported files give clearer feedback, reducing broken playback and improving review quality.
Weekly usage summary emails — automated weekly reports deliver key activity and adoption metrics by email to help teams monitor platform use without manual work.

weeks.label: Week of Apr 6, 2026
weeks.summary: This week focused on improving live session clarity and visibility: teleprompter availability, clearer participant and observer presentation, and updated release notes for recent changes.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Teleprompter is now visible to both interviewers and observers regardless of whether the session is being recorded, so everyone can follow prompts during live sessions.
Interviewer view now displays the number of observers, and observers are excluded from the participant grid so the participant list reflects only active session participants.
Release notes have been updated to include last week’s changes, making recent improvements and fixes easier to review.

weeks.label: Week of Mar 30, 2026
weeks.summary: This week we launched an interactive teleprompter for live sessions and tightened live-session behavior to reduce distractions and clarify participant permissions.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Interactive teleprompter for live sessions — hosts can open and control on-screen scripted text to pace presentations and guide delivery.
Synchronized teleprompter view for participants — remote attendees and observers see the same teleprompter content in real time so everyone follows the same cues.
Improved live-session safety and clarity — observers no longer receive media permissions, and non-critical publishing issues no longer create distracting notifications.

weeks.label: Week of Mar 23, 2026
weeks.summary: This week focused on making study takeaways and TLDR summaries more useful and easier to manage. Improvements include interactive takeaway management, automated and more accurate TLDR generation, clearer sourcing, and UI refinements for readability.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Add, edit, remove, and reorder study takeaways using drag-and-drop; list updates appear immediately in the interface and include clearer numbering and improved visual hierarchy for easier scanning.

TLDR summaries now start automatically when a study is completed, include heuristic and cognitive-walkthrough insights, and can be regenerated on demand so users always have an up-to-date concise summary.

Improved accuracy and relevance of AI-generated insights by better aligning generated results with their source questions and by requiring evidence-based findings; summaries can also present fewer than three takeaways when appropriate.
Added clear source attribution (AI, human, or hybrid) and refined list styling and typography so users can more easily understand the origin and priority of recommendations.

weeks.label: Week of Mar 16, 2026
weeks.summary: This week focused on documentation and stability: we updated our public release notes and there are no user-facing product changes. Your workflows and settings remain unchanged.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Published updated release notes so you can review recent change summaries and stay informed about past updates.
No user-facing changes this week — product functionality and your existing workflows remain the same.
Improved clarity of release summaries to make them easier to reference for team reviews and audits.

weeks.label: Week of Mar 9, 2026
weeks.summary: This week focused on making study creation smoother and more reliable, improving heuristic evaluation navigation, and clarifying live session status and participant presence.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Faster, simpler study creation: file upload is now the primary step, upload areas are fully clickable, and forms include a persistent submit bar so you can upload and complete studies more quickly and reliably on any screen size.
Improved heuristic evaluations: filter results by screen, the heuristic selector remembers your last choice, and search/display behavior is more intuitive to speed up review workflows.

Clearer live session handling: participants leaving are shown with a floating banner, and sessions that never started recording can be reverted back to scheduled so you can reschedule or retry easily.
UI stability fixes for forms and video: resolved form overflow and spacing issues and ensured video containers size correctly so layouts render properly across devices.
More reliable uploads: temporary upload links now remain valid for up to one hour, reducing failed uploads caused by expiring links during longer uploads.

weeks.label: Week of Mar 2, 2026
weeks.summary: This week focused on making live sessions more reliable, easier to run and moderate, and more useful after the session with improved analysis and transcripts. We also simplified study menus and added clearer cost and status visibility when creating and managing live sessions.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Live session list and scheduling improvements — scheduled sessions now show a clear "Scheduled" badge (previously labeled "Preview"), session cards and buttons are rearranged for clarity, and the session list updates in real time so you no longer need to manually refresh the page.

New hosting and moderation tools — hosts and moderators get dedicated interviewer and observer views plus a session toolbar, autosaved interviewer notes, and a cleaner participant view that hides your local camera when other participants are present while still showing screen shares.

More reliable session lifecycle and recordings — sessions are cleaned up automatically when finished, session status now correctly reflects whether recording actually started (sessions revert to Scheduled if no recording occurred), and session endings are handled more robustly to avoid orphaned or misleading session states.

Better post-session analysis and transcripts — transcripts now support speaker diarization for clearer speaker separation, a visible analysis status and a one-click "Run Analysis" action are available, and session outputs explicitly show processing and ended states so you can track progress and results.

Clearer cost and workspace controls — live session creation now shows estimated cost information, and study/analysis menus have been simplified (share options removed) for a more focused, easier-to-navigate experience.

weeks.label: Week of Feb 23, 2026
weeks.summary: This week’s release focuses on making qualitative analysis faster and more reliable: organized, AI-driven insights; seamless media playback with transcript navigation; easier and safer file uploads; clearer team fund controls and purchasing; plus several UI and performance refinements to speed review and iteration.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Structured qualitative analysis with clearer, consolidated insights and automatic organization (codebook generation and consolidation) so findings are more consistent and easier to act on. AI-generated study titles and cover images provide sensible defaults, and AI output is now constrained to avoid referencing internal process details.

Media playback and transcript synchronization inside analysis views — play media, click quotes or timestamps to jump to the exact moment, and see matched transcript context. Quote matching is more robust (supports varied formatting and ellipses) and highlights now include a legend to distinguish selections and cross-insight references.

Improved file handling for analyses: drag-and-drop uploads for interviews and context files, support for video and large-file transcription, and dynamic upload policies (limits on file count, size, and types) with clearer form labels and guidance to prevent confusion.

Enhanced team funds and purchasing controls: granular permissions for managing team funds, sidebar visibility that reflects user roles, a fund-based purchase flow with amount validation and updated refill behavior, and adjusted analysis pricing for clearer billing expectations.

Usability and performance improvements across the study experience — a new multi-section study creation form, “New” badges and reordered study options for easier discovery, inline title editing with keyboard shortcuts, bolder insight titles for readability, and performance optimizations to make highlights and transcript interactions snappier.

weeks.label: Week of Feb 16, 2026
weeks.summary: This week’s work delivers a major workflow addition for study plans, more reliable and meaningful evaluation scores, clearer billing/pricing behavior, and several quality improvements to team and persona visibility.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Create and view study plans: users can now create study plans, view plan details and metadata on plan pages, and receive customized completion notifications for plan-type studies.
More accurate evaluation scoring and grading: a new weighted scoring system and updated severity-to-grade mapping produce clearer, more consistent scores and grades across evaluation pages.

Clearer pricing and balance experience: pricing is now differentiated by study type and reflected in purchase and auto-refill flows; balance and ledger views have been updated, and checkout setup flows no longer affect account balances.

Team and persona visibility improvements plus UI polish: personas shared with a company are now correctly visible and filterable for team members; team context is shown in alerts and forms; sidebar team switching preserves search parameters; and command/input layout issues have been smoothed out.

weeks.label: Week of Feb 9, 2026
weeks.summary: This week’s release improves the heuristic evaluation experience with new ways to find and prioritize results, increases duplicate-detection accuracy, speeds up bulk file workflows, and polishes UI feedback for smoother interactions.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Sort and filter heuristic results — sort evaluations and filter by severity, source, or specific heuristics to find relevant findings faster.
Quality scoring in grading — evaluations now surface a quality score to help prioritize higher-impact items and compare results more clearly.
More accurate duplicate detection across screens — duplicate recognition has been improved to reduce manual review and better identify repeated items.
Faster bulk file handling for evaluations — multi-file actions are more efficient, making uploads/downloads and other bulk tasks quicker.
UI and loading improvements — clearer loading indicators and better placement of sorting controls for a more intuitive experience.

weeks.label: Week of Feb 2, 2026
weeks.summary: This week’s release improves content creation and browsing: richer persona authoring, smoother study creation with better file/import handling, and faster, clearer listing and library experiences.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Richer persona builder and details — persona creation now includes structured sections (demographics, firmographics, psychographics, behaviors), a custom-select option for tailored answers, and a clearer detail view with versioning and related studies to make persona management easier.

Smoother study and evaluation creation — improved file handling including uploads, design-file import, file management UI, progress indicators, and safer error boundaries so you can add assets to studies with clearer feedback and fewer interruptions.

Improved library browsing and submissions — the library now shows loading placeholders and clear error states, and submitting new heuristic sets is more reliable, making it easier to find and contribute content.

Faster, clearer listings and metadata — studies and teams load more quickly thanks to parallelized data loading, and listing pages now show counts, metadata cards, and contextual alerts so you can scan and act on information faster.
Simplified study creation options — a new StudyCard presentation makes it easier to review and pick study types when starting a new study.

weeks.label: Week of Jan 26, 2026
weeks.summary: Improvements this week focus on making evaluations easier to create and review: streamlined content import and uploads, smoother and more resilient forms, clearer study information while loading, and faster, better-organized heuristic results.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Import content directly when creating a new evaluation — upload files, bring in Figma designs, and extract content from videos. Upload progress and uploaded items are visible and manageable from the evaluation page.
Smoother, more resilient evaluation forms: inputs validate more gracefully as you type, the form handles loading issues without losing your work, and persona selection is easier to use.
Evaluation pages now show loading skeletons and a dedicated study details card so pages feel faster and study information is easier to scan at a glance.
Heuristic results load faster and are presented with clearer grouping and ordering, making issues easier to review and prioritize.

weeks.label: Week of Jan 19, 2026
weeks.summary: This week’s release improves team and credit settings with a redesigned team management experience, faster member selection and search, easier navigation of long lists, improved credit workflows, and reliability fixes for member updates.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Redesigned team management: creating teams, managing members, viewing team details, and adjusting permissions are now more discoverable and easier to use.

Faster member selection with role assignment and smarter search: add people more quickly, assign roles as you add them, and find teammates more efficiently. Accessibility improvements included for keyboard and assistive-device users.
Easier navigation of long lists: pagination added to settings lists so you can browse large teams and credit histories more smoothly.

Improved credit workflows: choose a team when purchasing or transferring credits, view recent purchases and a clearer transaction history, and benefit from better error handling on the credits page so issues surface with clear next steps.
More reliable member updates: removing a team member now provides immediate UI feedback and list updates are stable, eliminating intermittent reordering or flicker.

weeks.label: Week of Jan 12, 2026
weeks.summary: This week’s release improves media handling and analysis, streamlines team and account management, and polishes evaluation and settings interfaces for clearer, more reliable user workflows.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Faster, more accurate video analysis: dual-resolution frame extraction speeds up deduplication and improves the quality of AI-driven analysis.
Full-screen image previews: click any image to open a larger, better-fitting overlay with improved responsiveness and screen-reader accessibility.
Easier team management: invite members, activate/deactivate accounts, and permanently remove members from a unified set of dialogs with improved error handling and faster company settings loading.

Cleaner account and evaluation UI: sticky headers keep section context visible while scrolling, settings pages include reusable sections and clearer loading indicators, and heuristic exports now include issue severity for clearer reporting.
Resolved a brief stop-button re-enable issue so stop actions remain disabled until the redirect completes, preventing accidental repeat actions.

weeks.label: Week of Jan 5, 2026
weeks.summary: This week focused on reliability, security, and clearer user permissions across uploads, billing, and study workflows. Improvements reduce interruptions, make uploads and payments more dependable, and make team administration and study behavior more predictable.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Background processing is more resilient: the system now detects upstream service issues and stops repeated attempts during outages, keeping the app responsive and reducing study processing delays.
Image uploads are more secure and reliable: upload links now enforce ownership and team/company visibility, and improved validation and error handling reduce failed uploads and confusing failures.
Billing and credits behavior is more dependable: payment handling and auto-refill were improved and rate-limited to prevent duplicate refills and reduce unexpected billing issues.
Stronger team and admin controls: admin-only actions and role checks are enforced more consistently, making team management safer and reducing accidental permission problems.

More predictable study workflows and communications: study statuses and action responses were standardized for consistent behavior, and outgoing emails now use updated templates with an updated response time of one business day.

weeks.label: Week of Dec 29, 2025
weeks.summary: This week’s release introduces a first-class Figma plugin and a new in-app notification center, plus clearer heuristic evaluation views and several UI polish improvements to make collaboration and review workflows smoother.

sections.title: Highlights
items: New Figma plugin and improved integration: install the plugin to export and add designs between Seer and Figma, enjoy a clearer frame selection and export workflow, faster initialization and upload flows, visible progress/feedback during operations, and an easy 'Open in Seer' button after success.

In-app notifications: a notification center with Personal and Team tabs, admin audience filtering, and new notification types (study completed, study failed, and team credits exhausted) so individuals and teams receive timely, actionable updates.

Improved heuristic evaluations: evaluation pages now display all heuristics (including placeholders for non-violations) and include a clear grading system with grade badges and explanatory tooltips to make results easier to scan and understand.

General UX polish: updated icons and responsive labels on filter/sort controls, renamed 'Star' to 'Bookmark' for clearer study bookmarking, and various layout and button refinements for a more consistent, user-friendly interface.

weeks.label: Week of Dec 22, 2025
weeks.summary: This week’s release improves how teams and organizations share and manage studies and personas, and makes team navigation and access handling clearer and more reliable.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Share studies and personas with link-based sharing from both lists and detail views. Users can toggle share links on or off and choose team or personal visibility, with clearer tooltips and permission-aware options to prevent accidental exposure.

Simplified team navigation: a new sidebar team switcher (including a Join Team option), a prominent New button, and automatic navigation to the studies view when switching teams — making it faster to create, join, and switch teams.
Company claim workflow: request and manage pending company claims through a dedicated dialog and activation/rejection flow, streamlining how organizations are claimed and approved.

Improved access and persona handling: clearer access-denied messaging, better support for private personas, grouped persona selection, and more consistent persona display names to reduce confusion when access is restricted.

Accessibility and reliability improvements: added aria labels for copy actions, standardized icons and tooltips, improved logging, and expanded test coverage to make sharing and team flows more predictable and robust.

weeks.label: Week of Dec 15, 2025
weeks.summary: This week’s updates focus on richer media support, clearer import and onboarding experiences, and small UI refinements to make evaluations and account information easier to use.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Extract frames from uploaded videos so you can easily include video content as screenshots in evaluations and walkthroughs.
New Heuristics Library for browsing and managing heuristic checks directly in the app, making it simpler to reuse and organize evaluation criteria.

Improved design-file import handling and messaging: the app now shows clearer warnings and guidance when imports are incomplete or temporarily unavailable, and highlights cases where a design file contains only frames.
Studies page improvements: simplified wording and a helpful empty state guide new users and clarify next steps when no studies exist.
Updated image generation model to a newer version for improved image quality when creating visuals.
UI and messaging refinements: clearer long-flow warning wording, corrected layout for active team credits, and shortened card titles in purchase/transfer sections for a cleaner interface.

weeks.label: Week of Dec 8, 2025
weeks.summary: This week focused on making collaboration and workflows smoother: automated, easier-to-find release summaries; smoother team onboarding and invites; more reliable uploads; streamlined credit management; and better ways to find and bookmark studies.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Automated weekly release notes generated with AI-assisted summaries, plus an updated 'Updates' page and footer link with clearer timestamps for easier access to recent changes.

Simplified team onboarding and invitations: invite people directly to specific teams, see suggested members and helpful tooltips, and benefit from domain-based and pending-invite auto-enrollment to streamline new user setup.
New auto-refill for team credits: teams can enable recurring credit top-ups (including a zero-amount option) with improved controls for clearer billing and credit management.
Bookmarking and better study discovery: star studies to prioritize and access them across the app, and use new sorting and filtering options (by type and owner) to find relevant studies faster.
More reliable, faster file uploads with increased concurrency, automatic retry and connectivity handling to reduce failed uploads and improve the upload experience.

weeks.label: Week of Dec 1, 2025
weeks.summary: This week delivered a major refresh to how studies are listed and managed, added an integrated design-file workflow, and improved the public site and sign-in reliability to create a more polished, consistent user experience.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Redesigned Studies view: a new compact list replaces individual cards and adds fuzzy search, sortable columns, page-size selection with saved preferences, loading skeletons and inline tooltips for smoother browsing. Column labels updated to “Owner” and “Updated” for clearer context.

Design-file integration: you can now connect a design file integration from your account and post comments from study workflows using in-app dialogs and controls, making it easier to collaborate on findings directly from the app.

Improved reliability and messaging for the design-file integration: clearer alerts and better handling when the external design service is limited or unavailable, so you get more useful feedback when actions can’t complete immediately.

Public site and outreach updates: new homepage layout (hero, capabilities, data-safety, customer logos), revamped pricing and FAQ, a new contact page, and a demo request form with submission handling and a consistent footer (including a LinkedIn link) to improve discoverability and conversions.

Sign-in and session improvements: refreshed sign-in styling and external sign-in button, plus stronger session checks to ensure you’re signed in before submitting forms, reducing failed or duplicate submissions.

weeks.label: Week of Nov 24, 2025
weeks.summary: This week’s release focuses on improved credit management and purchasing, higher-quality evaluation results, and several usability improvements to uploads, deletion safeguards, and policy communications.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Streamlined credit management: you can now purchase credits via a secure checkout flow, view recent purchases and a credit ledger, transfer credits between teams, and see team-specific remaining credits. The Credits page and sidebar respect access permissions and simplify the purchase experience.

More relevant, easier-to-use evaluations: AI-generated issues and recommendations are now deduplicated and filtered by study goals, and heuristic reviews include adjacent-screen context—resulting in fewer duplicates and more actionable findings. The results UI also surfaces counts of violated heuristics to speed triage.

Safer content handling and clearer feedback: the app prevents deleting personas that are in use and shows informative tooltips when deletion is disabled. Submissions now clean up orphaned studies and provide toast notifications on failures so you get immediate, useful feedback.

Smoother uploads and prototype support: Figma uploads now carry prototype metadata, file inputs let you re-select the same file without extra steps, and preview cards handle image blobs more reliably for a more consistent upload and preview experience.

Usability and clarity fixes: no-credits messaging is clearer and dismissible, credit counts now display as whole numbers, and UI visibility/resize issues (including mobile heuristic indicators) have been corrected for more consistent behavior.

weeks.label: Week of Nov 17, 2025
weeks.summary: This week’s release strengthens team and account controls, improves permissions and audit visibility, introduces a credits settings page, and polishes content and media experiences.

sections.title: Highlights
items: More powerful team and member management: admins can activate, deactivate, remove, or permanently erase members (GDPR-compliant), preserve personal teams when removing users, and see clearer status filters and controls. Companies can define default auto-join teams (with a toggle to disable personal teams) and users will be enrolled into default teams automatically.

Stronger access controls and clearer permissions: deactivated members are prevented from accessing company pages, team admins can manage team studies, persona creation and selection respects company/team permissions, and company-level personas are now available where you pick personas. Study pages now show who last modified them for better auditability.

Safer account, company, and credits controls: added a credits settings page and clearer credits display/actions; a new personal account danger zone for deletion; and improved company deletion that removes associated users and proceeds reliably while providing clearer messaging.

Improved content feedback and media display: ratings on study content are now optional and duplicate rating validation has been fixed, feedback controls are hidden for non-AI content, gallery images render with more reliable sizing and layout, and avatar fallbacks have improved contrast for readability.

weeks.label: Week of Nov 10, 2025
weeks.summary: This week’s updates make team membership and team navigation more transparent and easier to use, and improve visibility for in-progress studies.

sections.title: Highlights
items: When requesting to join a team you can include a personal note; team admins can provide a reason when declining. Requesters receive clear notifications with the outcome and any rejection reason.
Team admins are now notified when new join requests arrive, so requests are acted on more promptly.
A new Team Switcher lets you switch your active team from the studies view and other team screens; the selected team is reflected in the URL so links keep your current context.
Study listings now surface pending persona studies even if they have no records yet, making in-progress work easier to find and track.

weeks.label: Week of Nov 3, 2025
weeks.summary: This week’s updates focus on better team collaboration controls, richer usability issue triage, and more reliable study runs with clearer feedback.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Easier team discovery and management: browse teams with visible descriptions and member counts, request to join from the UI, and let team administrators configure join policies (open, request, invite-only/secret) as well as edit team names and descriptions.
Severity ratings for usability issues: add and view severity when logging or reviewing issues and evaluation results to help prioritize work; items without a rating are clearly shown as “None”.
Inline severity management: severity is displayed on issue cards and can be updated directly from the card for faster triage and clearer issue context.

More reliable studies and clearer failure handling: re-running a study replaces previous results to avoid confusion, and studies that fail now show clearer status and messages so you can retry or investigate.

Improved sign-in and file fetch feedback: Google sign-in works better in embedded browsers, and prototype file fetch failures now provide clearer, actionable error messages so you know why a fetch didn’t succeed.

weeks.label: Week of Oct 27, 2025
weeks.summary: This week’s updates focus on persona versioning and improved list navigation, plus a permissions fix to ensure owners can edit personas reliably.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Persona versioning: create and manage multiple versions of a persona, view version details in the persona details area and on study cards, and see which studies relate to a specific persona version. Study lists now prioritize the latest persona versions to reduce confusion.
Pagination for company teams and members: large team and member lists now include pagination with clear navigation controls, making it easier to browse and find people.
Edit permissions corrected: owners can now consistently edit their personas without unexpected restrictions.

weeks.label: Week of Oct 20, 2025
weeks.summary: This week’s release focuses on richer, more reliable persona management: users can now edit and save personas with better validation and image support, plus expanded profile fields and smoother form interactions.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Edit and save personas directly: you can update persona profiles from the app with built-in validation and image handling to ensure updates are saved correctly and consistently.
Richer persona profiles: added employment status, annual recurring revenue, and tool-related fields (including expertise) so profiles capture more complete, actionable information.

Improved form usability: the persona form now manages tool inputs more intuitively, reorganizes channel/industry choices for clarity, and automatically clears budget ranges when “No influence” is selected to reduce mistakes.
Better persona images: image prompts and image handling were refined to produce more relevant and higher-quality persona visuals.
More reliable updates and feedback: persona save operations now provide clearer feedback and handle issues more robustly so users experience fewer interruptions during edits.

weeks.label: Week of Oct 13, 2025
weeks.summary: This week we launched a complete Heuristics Library and management experience, streamlined how teams create and organize heuristic sets, and improved the clarity and reliability of heuristic evaluations.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Browse, create, and manage heuristic families in a new Library view—find company and custom heuristics, create new families, and see family-level details for easier organization.

Build custom heuristic sets with a redesigned form: drag-and-drop ordering, clearer labels and validation, add/cancel flow, and admin-only controls for adding company-specific heuristics—making set creation faster and less error-prone.
View detailed heuristic pages that surface ownership and family context, and a clearer examples section that provides better messaging and a fallback when no examples exist.

Improved heuristic evaluations and AI persona generation: results now include label, description, and examples for clearer insight, and the evaluation process better respects company access and handles failures more gracefully.
Team-switching now updates views dynamically (for example, on the Studies page), so changing teams refreshes content immediately without extra steps.

weeks.label: Week of Oct 6, 2025
weeks.summary: This week focused on expanding heuristics functionality and improving team/study handling. Users can create and apply custom heuristics more easily, heuristics load more reliably, and team-related data and assets move and refresh more predictably.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Create and manage custom heuristics, organized into families, and select them directly within the evaluation form. Selections update the form immediately so you can apply and review heuristics without extra steps.
Improved heuristics loading and reliability with family-aware handling and clearer responses when a heuristic cannot be loaded, resulting in more consistent evaluation behavior.
Transfer studies between teams while preserving associated files and study data, making it easier to change ownership or reorganize work across teams.
Persona images are now tied to teams so personas remain consistent and shared correctly among team members after team changes.
Switching teams now refreshes user and study lists automatically, so you see the correct, up-to-date data immediately after changing teams.

weeks.label: Week of Sep 29, 2025
weeks.summary: This week’s work improves the usefulness and consistency of our automated UX evaluations and includes a small UI polish to make the interface cleaner.

sections.title: Highlights
items: AI-generated cognitive walkthroughs and heuristic evaluations now produce more actionable guidance, with explicit references to concrete UI and UX elements and recommendations tied to user goals.
Evaluations place stronger emphasis on the target user, producing recommendations that are better aligned to user needs and decision-making contexts.
Evaluations now handle missing or incomplete target-user information more gracefully, maintaining relevance and clarity when details are not provided.
Improved layout spacing in interface components for more consistent, readable presentation.

weeks.label: Week of Sep 22, 2025
weeks.summary: This week’s release improves evaluation workflows and study browsing, strengthens team management and billing, and makes automated evaluations and CSV exports more reliable and user-friendly.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Evaluation and walkthrough forms are easier and more reliable: clearer instructions and placeholders, stronger validation and error handling, submit buttons disabled until forms are complete, and a redesigned asset carousel with drag-and-drop, image sorting, and higher upload limits.
CSV exports now preserve original file names and use consistent formatting, making exported data simpler to reconcile with source files.

Team management and billing are more intuitive: rename teams inline or from settings, view membership status (and exclude deactivated users from enrollment), see team credits in the sidebar, and ensure studies charge the currently selected team.
Automated evaluations (heuristic and walkthrough) are faster and more consistent thanks to batched processing and improved retry/reliability behavior, resulting in steadier evaluation results.

Improved study and content handling: Figma imports focus on frames from the active page and traverse prototypes more accurately, persona pages include a related-studies carousel, and study cards/links have been polished for more reliable browsing.

weeks.label: Week of Sep 15, 2025
weeks.summary: This week we focused on making team management simpler and more reliable, and on improving the sign‑in experience with one‑time codes and clearer cooldown messaging, along with several UI polish and reliability fixes.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Easier team switching and management: a team selector is now available in the top navigation, company members can be invited directly to teams, team member lists are searchable and show richer member details, and team settings are now scoped to users who administer those teams with improved empty‑state handling.

More reliable, user-friendly sign-in with one-time codes: full OTP email sign-in implemented with request rate limiting and cooldowns, clearer formatted cooldown messages, and protections to prevent automatic token consumption by email scanners.

UI polish and consistency across navigation and team pages: improved popover and dropdown sizing and alignment, updated spacing and button behavior, and action toasts (like team creation) remaining visible when appropriate.
Improved sign-in messaging and error handling: clearer button and email copy, better handling of OTP input errors (messages clear on input change), and fixes to email templates for reliable delivery.

weeks.label: Week of Sep 8, 2025
weeks.summary: This week’s release improves company and team management workflows: users can claim and track company ownership, admins have review tools, and managing members and teams is faster and clearer.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Company claim and approval workflow — users can request ownership of a company by domain, see clear claim status messages, receive improved notification emails, and administrators can review and approve or manage pending claims with proper authorization.

Better member management — the company members list now supports search and sorting, members can be updated from the settings area, and membership roles are surfaced throughout the app so only authorized users see and access company settings.

Streamlined team creation and invites — company admins can create teams and invite members in a single flow, with improved member selection controls, a toggle to show or hide personal teams, and automatic association of personal teams to a company based on email where applicable.

Improved join and invite experience — clearer company-join messaging with a confirmation checkbox, refined invite emails and dialog spacing, and updated section labeling for a more consistent settings experience.

weeks.label: Week of Sep 1, 2025
weeks.summary: This week’s release strengthens team and organization workflows, improves export and print output, and streamlines how credits are managed for study creation.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Manage your organization from the app: a new Organization Settings area and updated Account Settings let you view and update company details, upload a company logo, create a company for your email domain, and manage team membership and invitations from one place.

Team-level credit management: credits are now handled at the team level (your existing personal balance has been consolidated into your personal team), with consistent credit consumption across study creation forms and a visible ledger of team credit activity.
Export and print improvements: you can now export heuristic evaluations to PDF, and print layouts have been refined for cleaner, more accurate output restricted to print mode for consistent results.
Improved navigation and account access: the user menu now surfaces your organization context and includes clearer Account Settings access so you can reach organization and account controls faster.
Resolved company branding display issues so company name and logo now show correctly in account and organization views.

weeks.label: Week of Aug 25, 2025
weeks.summary: This week’s release focuses on clearer team ownership, richer persona profiles, and smoother study workflows with several user-facing UI improvements for a more consistent and reliable experience.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Automatic personal teams for users and consistent team context: new accounts now get a personal team created and selected by default, and studies are associated with the user’s active team so ownership and team context are clearer and more consistent.

Richer persona profiles: added job title and ethnicity fields and increased persona description length to 500 characters, along with updated demographic icons for more accurate participant representation.

Smoother study and form workflows: study names will auto-update to match a provided persona; completing a study refreshes the view so results appear immediately; forms now prevent accidental submissions (including when place suggestions are visible) and disable submit when no meaningful values are entered.
UI polish and layout consistency: improved button visibility, avatar sizing, and loading states (skeletons) across study and profile screens for clearer, more consistent interfaces.

weeks.label: Week of Aug 18, 2025
weeks.summary: This week focused on end-to-end persona functionality and smoother study workflows: you can create and view richer personas, pick them when running evaluations, and benefit from multiple UI and form fixes for clearer, more consistent interactions.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Create and view richer personas: personas now support profile photos, cover images, a demographics section with icons and descriptions, and clearer budget options so profiles are more descriptive and easier to scan.

Attach and use personas in studies: you can now associate a persona with heuristic evaluations and cognitive walkthroughs, see persona details directly on evaluation and walkthrough pages, and navigate from study screens to the persona details.

Improved persona selection experience: inline persona selection has better focus and input handling for keyboard and mouse users, making it faster and more reliable to pick the right persona during study setup.

Forms and inputs are more reliable: persona handling in evaluation and walkthrough forms was corrected, heuristic values are normalized for consistency, and budget options were clarified to reduce confusion.
Visual and layout polish across persona and list views: improved text wrapping, icon and cover alignment, margins, and list rendering for better readability and a more consistent look and feel.

weeks.label: Week of Aug 11, 2025
weeks.summary: This week we shipped a complete persona creation experience and improved how personas and studies are processed, with UI refinements to make forms and retries more reliable and easier to use.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Create and manage personas: a new persona creation workflow lets you add optional name, description, images, goals, locations, and purchase triggers with flexible input formats, so building rich customer personas is faster and more flexible.
Persona visuals: personas can now have generated and processed images, giving each persona a clearer visual representation without extra manual steps.
Use personas in studies: a new persona study type and improved study initialization let you run studies tied to a persona and prefill study details from the persona for a smoother setup.

More reliable study processing and retry behavior: background processing now includes stronger validation and clearer retry/polling UI, making it easier to retry failed studies and understand progress; CSV exports now preserve step values.

Improved form experience and UI controls: forms were reorganized with accordion sections and better layout, file handling now prevents accidental overwrites on cancel, and new input components (including list and location editors, and improved popover/command controls) make data entry more intuitive.

weeks.label: Week of Aug 4, 2025
weeks.summary: This week’s release improves account controls and notification management, streamlines study workflows with file support, and delivers interface and accessibility polish for a more consistent, reliable experience.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Manage your account profile more easily: update your name with validation, upload or remove your profile image, and access the new Account page from the main navigation.

Control your notifications with a dedicated Communication Preferences panel: view and update your settings with Save/Cancel, and all existing and new accounts now have default preferences so settings behave predictably.

Simplified study workflows: initializing and finalizing studies (including both walkthroughs and evaluations) now supports attaching and handling related files, making it easier to start, complete, and collect assets for research.
Interface and accessibility improvements: reduced layout shifts, improved button accessibility and cursor behavior, aligned input styling, and clearer breadcrumb labels for smoother navigation.
Visual consistency update across the app: spacing, layout, and component styles have been refreshed for a more uniform and responsive user interface.

weeks.label: Week of Jul 28, 2025
weeks.summary: This week’s work focused on reliability, diagnostics, and user experience—improving error handling, adding application-wide logging, polishing UI interactions, and making evaluation workflows more reliable.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Clearer, more helpful error and “not found” pages for both signed-in and public routes so users see actionable messaging and can recover more smoothly when something goes wrong.
Integrated application-wide logging and diagnostics that capture sign-in and credit-request activity, helping the team detect and resolve issues faster and improving overall reliability.
Polished UI and interactions: the More menu and other interface elements now present more consistent styling and animations for a cleaner, more predictable experience.

Improved evaluation workflows: creating, submitting, and viewing cognitive walkthroughs and heuristic evaluations is more reliable, with more consistent result ordering and better handling when renaming or saving studies.
Stronger validation and user feedback for file uploads in evaluation forms, reducing invalid submissions and making it clearer when uploaded files aren’t accepted.

weeks.label: Week of Jul 21, 2025
weeks.summary: This week’s release focuses on reliability and observability: user sessions and access checks were strengthened, page error handling was improved for clearer feedback, and server logging was standardized to speed up issue resolution while reducing noise and sensitive data in logs.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Strengthened session validation on Studies, Walkthrough, and Evaluation pages so only authenticated users can access content and users receive clear guidance when their session is invalid.
Improved error handling and user-facing feedback on Studies, Walkthrough, and Evaluation pages to reduce failed loads and make recovery or retry actions clearer.

Enhanced server-side logging and monitoring with structured logs and production-only log streaming, improving visibility for faster incident detection and resolution while minimizing noise in non-production environments.
Reduced sensitive user details in logs and standardized log messages to improve privacy and make diagnostics clearer and safer.

weeks.label: Week of Jul 14, 2025
weeks.summary: This week focused on improving operational visibility and polishing the Evaluation and Walkthrough experience: clearer logging and health metrics, easier prototype import and feedback, better content organization, stronger user context capture, and updated legal pages and navigation.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Improved structured logging and health metrics across background services so issues are easier to detect and diagnose, leading to more reliable operation and faster response to problems.
Added prototype URL import to the evaluation form and improved file handling and validation messages so importing designs is simpler and failures give clear, actionable feedback.
Walkthrough steps now support collapsible sections and include a gallery view for additional context, improving readability and organization of long or complex content.
Forms and outputs now capture and display target user and submitter information with validation, so evaluations and walkthroughs include clearer context and traceability.

Published updated Terms and Privacy pages and refined breadcrumbs and navigation across Walkthroughs and Evaluations for clearer legal information and smoother navigation; obsolete pages were removed.

weeks.label: Week of Jul 7, 2025
weeks.summary: This week’s release focuses on a stronger Cognitive Walkthrough experience, improved study retry and attempt tracking, and reliability and UI polish across the app.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Redesigned Cognitive Walkthrough view with a dedicated header, clearer results layout, visible step counts, and improved filtering so teams can navigate walkthroughs and locate findings faster.

Create, delete, and manage walkthrough issues directly from the interface, plus add and remove recommendations; support for learnability, usability, and discoverability issue types makes documenting findings more complete and actionable.
Study retry and attempt tracking: studies now record attempt counts and support retries, and credits are handled correctly when a study is retried so teams can rerun studies without losing credits.

Improved reliability and polish: resolved Google sign-in problems for a smoother authentication flow, and refined component spacing and mobile behavior (including hiding the create-issue button on small screens) for a tidier, more usable UI.

weeks.label: Week of Jun 9, 2025
weeks.summary: This week we launched a redesigned pricing experience and improved the credit purchase request flow, while also applying visual and layout polish across the site for clearer, more consistent presentation.

sections.title: Highlights
items: New pricing page with a clear table layout that makes it easier to compare plans and understand what’s included in each tier.
On-site credit purchase requests: users can submit requests directly from the pricing page and receive a confirmation to acknowledge their request.
Updated and styled confirmation and request emails with clearer messaging and improved branding for a more professional, consistent communication experience.
Site-wide visual and layout improvements — more consistent spacing, theme-aware header styling, and an updated homepage layout — to improve readability and overall visual consistency.

weeks.label: Week of Jun 2, 2025
weeks.summary: This week’s updates make exported reports richer and the heuristic list easier to read, so you can trace findings more clearly and analyze them faster.

sections.title: Highlights
items: CSV and Excel exports now include heuristic, issue, and recommendation IDs so rows can be traced back to specific items and integrated with external workflows.
Exports also include heuristic category and label, making it simpler to group, filter, and analyze findings in spreadsheets.
Improved heuristic list presentation with clearer label rendering and updated badge styling to make items easier to scan and understand at a glance.

weeks.label: Week of May 26, 2025
weeks.summary: This week’s release focuses on better data portability, more accurate live study status, and improved heuristic list usability across devices.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Export study and heuristic data directly to CSV and Excel from the More menu for easy sharing and offline analysis.
Study pages now update status automatically (every 15 seconds) so progress and state stay current without manual refresh.
Heuristics can now include category and label metadata, making it easier to organize and filter findings.
Improved layout and mobile responsiveness for the heuristic list and header, providing clearer navigation and actions on smaller screens.
Resolved a display issue in the heuristic accordion to ensure consistent behavior and interaction on both mobile and desktop.
